notes: Official BIP 341 wallet test vectors. The 7 scriptPubKey entries drive python/tests/test_taproot.py: given.internalPubkey and intermediary.merkleRoot (null meaning no script tree, the empty atom) pin the tweak scalar, the tweaked output key, and the final scriptPubKey of the CREATE_OUTPUT_TAPROOT derivation. The keyPathSpending section covers signing and is unused, as are the script-tree construction fields, since BitLisp consumes the merkle root as an opaque committed value.
